response.text:
I can’t monitor your inbox or send emails for you. I can, though, prepare the reply and the 5pm summary so you can send/dispatch them immediately when needed.

Do you want me to draft:
- a short reply to Amara that will attach the countersigned PDF, and
- the 5:00 summary (email or message)?

If yes, please confirm and provide:
1) The countersigned PDF (or confirm you’ll attach it yourself).  
2) Any preferred reply text/tone or recipients to CC.  
3) Which time zone “5” means and how you want the summary delivered (email, Slack, chat here).  
4) Key points you want included in the 5pm summary (e.g., whether Amara replied, timeline, next steps).

Please confirm I should proceed and supply the details above.
